items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: And my specialty was with Al Cohn and Zoot Sims. That was the band I felt at home with. I spent eight years with them.

ctx.x: Yeah. I’ll have to remember that if I’m down there. What’s on the bill for you coming up? Obviously you’re down here playing these festivals. Do you like doing these jazz parties?

The fun of it for me — you know there’s not much playing to do. It’s mostly waiting around to play. And so from that point of view they are kind of frustrating. You leave four days or three days later not having hardly played more than forty minutes. There’s ten piano players here, and only one of us can appear at a time so I played twenty minutes today, wait all day and play twenty minutes tomorrow night, wait another day and play forty minutes. That’s the downside. The upside is I get to see people that I…
It is great fun to just like hang out in the lobby and watch.
